column1: The lectures were clear and engaging. The instructor provided helpful feedback.
Assignments were confusing and the grading criteria were unclear.
I appreciated the practical labs; they reinforced the theory well.
The course was excellent overall, but some topics needed more explanation.
The online discussion board was poorly organized, and it was difficult to find posts.
The exam questions covered very minor details that weren't emphasized in lectures.
Great course! The professor was very responsive to questions.
The workload was too heavy for a 3-credit course.
I learned a lot and the materials were well-structured.
The grading was inconsistent and feedback was often delayed.
